::: {.callout-important title="This is a two-chapter pilot, not the complete workbook"}
This document contains **only Chapters 1 and 2** of *Modern LLM
Architecture: A Visual Guide to Attention, Memory, Sparsity, and Hybrid
Models* (workbook 04 of the ML/LLM Study Workbooks series). Chapters
3-8 -- attention head structure and cache-efficient variants, restricting
attention's reach, mixture-of-experts models, case studies, architecture
-> systems consequences, and a synthesis/practice chapter -- are planned
but **not drafted**. Nothing in this document should be read as
implying those chapters exist yet.

This is a review artifact: it exists to establish the workbook's
explanatory depth, visual language, page density, question style, and
citation style before the remaining six chapters are drafted at scale.
Treat any rough edge you find as exactly the kind of thing this pilot
is meant to surface early.
:::
